{{Youmay|the Sith construct|[[Focusing Chamber|weapon component]] used in [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]]}}
The '''focusing chamber''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] construct, buried deep underground, and served as a place where the energy of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] could be focused and channeled to a specific individual. When a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] used a focusing chamber their ability to wield the Force substantially increased temporarily.
